scripts.build: pnpm run check:font && pnpm run check:routes && vite build
scripts.build:staging: pnpm run check:font && pnpm run check:routes && vite build --mode staging
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:worker && pnpm run check:worker:staging
scripts.deploy:pages: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./dist --project-name=kpj-web --force
scripts.deploy:pages:staging: pnpm run build:staging && wrangler pages deploy ./dist --project-name=kpj-web --branch staging
scripts.deploy:worker: pnpm run check:routes && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml --env=""
scripts.deploy:worker:staging: pnpm run check:routes && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml --env staging
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:pages && pnpm run deploy:worker
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run deploy:pages:staging && pnpm run deploy:worker:staging
